scope: Title and complete rendered ItemBody for the assigned frozen set-theory items; local previews only.

findings.excerpt: title: Under MA(aleph_1), arbitrary products of ccc spaces are ccc
findings.symptom: The title shows the cardinal subscript as the literal text "aleph_1". The Statement typesets the corresponding notation as $\mathrm{MA}(\aleph_1)$.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the title notation, for example "$\mathrm{MA}(\aleph_1)$, arbitrary products of ccc spaces are ccc".

findings.excerpt: In ZFC, for a regular uncountable cardinal kappa, the following are equivalent: kappa is strongly compact; every P_kappa(lambda), for a cardinal lambda>=kappa, carries a fine kappa-complete ultrafilter; ...
findings.symptom: Mathematical symbols in the complete Statement and two proof steps are written as unformatted ASCII names and operators ("kappa", "lambda>=kappa", "P_kappa(lambda)", and "kappa-complete"). Other formulas in the same item are typeset, so notation changes form within the same claim and proof.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the mathematical symbols consistently, for example $\kappa$, $\lambda\ge\kappa$, $\mathcal P_\kappa(\lambda)$, and "\kappa-complete" as $\kappa$-complete.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** contradiction for uncountability of the ground limit, followed by leastness of $\omega_1$.
findings.symptom: The Proof technique label is visually uppercased by the renderer, turning the inline TeX control sequence into the literal-looking "$\OMEGA_1$" in the rendered label. The same notation in the Statement body renders correctly.
findings.suggested_repair: Use plain text such as "leastness of omega-one" in the Proof technique metadata, or prevent the label’s uppercase styling from transforming math.
